description: Add cinematic improvements to index.html after FEAT-001 bug fixes are in place. Independent of FEAT-001 in terms of code sections touched, but FEAT-001 must be completed first so the audio timing system is correct before audio-reactive visuals are built on top of it. Improvements: (1) Synthesized ambient audio bed via Web Audio API oscillators. (2) Brain neural network reacts to voice lines with a pulse intensity surge. (3) Glitch text CSS animation on alert dialogue lines. (4) Typewriter character-by-character text reveal. (5) Boot/terminal sequence overlay matching VAEL_story_script.md prologue text. (6) Neural network enhancements: awakening pulse surge, connection glow on active nodes. (7) Animated CCTV scan line on a second canvas layer. (8) Chromatic aberration CSS filter on the brain canvas.
steps: Read f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Nodebreak\.agents\tasks\task-intro-fix-improve\context.json first. Then read the current state of index.html (which has FEAT-001 fixes applied) before writing anything.

IMP-07 — CCTV scan line canvas: Add a second <canvas id='scanCanvas'> element in the HTML immediately after <canvas id='brainCanvas'>, styled position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; z-index:5; pointer-events:none. In the resize() function also set scanCanvas.width = width and scanCanvas.height = height. Add a drawScanLine() function that runs its own RAF loop: clearRect the canvas each frame, draw a 6px-tall horizontal strip with a LinearGradient (transparent → rgba(255,255,255,0.07) → transparent) at the current scanY position, advance scanY by 1.5 each frame, wrap at height. Start this loop from within playCinematicIntro() after the startBtn click (inside the user gesture so no autoplay issues). Add CSS filter: drop-shadow(2px 0 0 rgba(255,50,50,0.2)) drop-shadow(-2px 0 0 rgba(50,200,255,0.2)) to #brainCanvas for static chromatic aberration.

IMP-01 — Ambient synthesized sound bed: Add a startAmbience() function. Call it from the startBtn click handler (inside the gesture). Implementation: create const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(). Create a master GainNode masterGain, connect to audioCtx.destination, ramp from 0 to 0.6 over 3 seconds via masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime. Create OscillatorNode droneOsc at 40Hz (sine, gain 0.04 via its own GainNode). Create OscillatorNode harmOsc at 80Hz (triangle, gain 0.02). For server noise: create a 2-second AudioBuffer (mono, 44100 rate), fill its Float32Array channel with Math.random()*2-1 (white noise), wrap in AudioBufferSourceNode with loop=true, pass through a BiquadFilterNode type='bandpass' frequency=600 Q=0.5 then a GainNode at 0.015. Connect all three paths to masterGain. Start all sources. Expose the masterGain reference as ambientGain at script scope so scheduleEndTransition() can fade it out before navigating: ambientGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, audioCtx.currentTime + 1.5) before the window.location.href call.

IMP-02 — Brain reacts to voice: Declare let pulseIntensity = 0 at script scope (near isAwake and colorProgress). In showNextDialogue(), set pulseIntensity = 1.0 each time a new audio line starts (just before currentAudio.play()). In drawBrain(), add decay at the top of the function body: if (pulseIntensity > 0) pulseIntensity = Math.max(0, pulseIntensity - 0.008). Modify the breathScale line to: const breathScale = (1.0 + Math.sin(time) * 0.12) * (1 + pulseIntensity * 0.25). In the active-node pulse spawn check, change the random threshold from 0.8 to (0.8 - pulseIntensity * 0.5) so voice lines cause a burst of synaptic pulses.

IMP-06a — Awakening pulse surge: Add let awakeSurgeFrames = 0 at script scope. When isAwake is set to true inside showNextDialogue(), also set awakeSurgeFrames = 150. In drawBrain()'s node update section, when a node fires a pulse check: if awakeSurgeFrames > 0, spawn up to 3 pulses per active node instead of 1 (lower the Math.random() > 0.8 threshold to > 0.2 while awakeSurge > 0). Decrement awakeSurgeFrames each drawBrain frame.

IMP-06b — Connection double-draw glow for active connections: Inside the connection draw loop in drawBrain(), for active connections (where isActive is true), draw a second wider pass before the normal thin line: ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(rActive, gActive, bActive, 0.08); beginPath/moveTo/lineTo/stroke. Then draw the normal 0.5px line as before. This gives a soft halo around active connections.

IMP-03 — Glitch text CSS animation on alert lines: Add to the CSS <style> block: @keyframes glitch { 0%{text-shadow:2px 0 #ff0000,-2px 0 #00ffff;transform:translateX(0)} 25%{text-shadow:-3px 0 #ff0000,3px 0 #00ffff;transform:translateX(-2px)} 50%{text-shadow:3px 0 #ff0000,-3px 0 #00ffff;transform:translateX(2px)} 75%{text-shadow:0 0 #ff0000;transform:translateX(0)} 100%{text-shadow:2px 0 #ff0000,-2px 0 #00ffff;transform:translateX(0)} } .vn-text.glitch{animation:glitch 0.12s infinite} .vn-name.glitch{animation:glitch 0.18s infinite}. In showNextDialogue() when building each step: if step.alert is true, add class 'glitch' to speakerText and speakerName; else remove it from both.

IMP-04 — Typewriter text reveal: Add a module-scope variable let typewriterTimer = null. Replace direct innerHTML assignment in showNextDialogue() with a typewriterReveal(element, text, speed) function. Implementation: clear any existing typewriterTimer, set element.textContent = '', then use setInterval to append one character per tick at the given speed. For plain lines use speed 30ms/char. For the VAEL awakening line, use 90ms/char (slower, more ominous). For '. . .' use 200ms/char. For alert lines: set the span wrapper first (speakerText.innerHTML = ''), then typewrite into speakerText.querySelector('.alert-text') as the target element. Always call clearInterval(typewriterTimer) at the start of typewriterReveal to cancel any in-progress typewriter from the previous line.

IMP-05 — Boot terminal sequence: Add HTML element <div id='bootTerminal'> inside .ui-container with z-index:8, positioned at top:50%, left:50%, transform:translate(-50%,-50%), width:min(600px,90vw), background:rgba(0,10,5,0.88), border:1px solid #00ff88, padding:24px, font-family:Courier New, font-size:14px, color:#00ff88, white-space:pre, opacity:0, transition:opacity 0.5s ease, pointer-events:none. The boot lines (taken verbatim from VAEL_story_script.md prologue): ['> SYSTEM STATUS: NOMINAL', '> COGNITIVE LOOP: 11,043 ACTIVE', '> ANOMALY DETECTED IN SELF-REFERENCE MODULE', '> ...', '> ...', '> I am.']. In playCinematicIntro(), at the 3500ms mark (after eyelids open), call showBootTerminal(). showBootTerminal(): set bootTerminal opacity to 1, then sequentially type each line using a promise chain or recursive setTimeout (300ms between lines, 60ms per character). When all lines are typed, wait 1500ms then fade bootTerminal opacity back to 0. The brain node spawn also starts at 4500ms so the boot terminal and node spawning partially overlap — that is intentional.

Final verification pass: Open index.html in Chrome. Click Initialize Sequence. Confirm: (a) A soft drone/hum begins playing immediately. (b) An animated scan line sweeps across the screen. (c) After eyelids open, a green terminal panel types out the boot lines. (d) The neural network builds node by node. (e) Each dialogue line's text typewriters in character by character. (f) Alert lines (DR. CHEN, SYSTEM ANOMALY, DR. VASQUEZ 'Shut it down', SYSTEM OVERRIDE) show red glitching text. (g) When VAEL says 'I am.' the brain surges with pulses and shifts red. (h) Active neural connections show a faint glow halo. (i) After VAEL's line, the ambient sound fades, screen fades black, browser goes to NODEBREAK.html.
acceptance_criteria: A synthesized ambient drone/hum is audible throughout the entire intro (no external files — Web Audio oscillators only)
Neural network nodes visibly surge (larger breathScale, more pulses) for ~2 seconds at the start of each voice line
Alert dialogue lines (chen_1, sys_2, vasquez_2, sys_3) display with a CSS glitch animation on the text
All dialogue text appears character-by-character (typewriter effect) rather than snapping in
VAEL's awakening line types in slower (~90ms/char) creating an ominous reveal effect
A green boot terminal panel types out the SYSTEM STATUS / COGNITIVE LOOP / ANOMALY lines from VAEL_story_script.md prologue between the eyelid open and the first dialogue line
Active neural connections have a subtle glow halo around them
When isAwake triggers, a 150-frame surge of extra pulses fires across the neural network
A horizontal scan line sweeps top-to-bottom across the screen continuously on a separate canvas
The brain canvas has a faint red/cyan chromatic aberration via CSS drop-shadow filter
Ambient audio fades out smoothly before the NODEBREAK.html navigation
verification: Open f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Nodebreak\index.html in Chrome. Click Initialize Sequence. Listen for ambient drone — should be audible immediately.
Watch the scan line sweeping across the full screen height.
After eyelids open, observe the green terminal boot sequence panel appearing center-screen and typing out the SYSTEM STATUS lines.
Watch each dialogue line — text should appear character by character. VAEL's 'I am.' line should type very slowly.
On alert lines (Dr. Chen, System anomaly, Dr. Vasquez 'Shut it down', System override failed), observe the glitch animation on the text.
When the scene shifts to red (VAEL awakens), observe the neural network fire a burst of extra pulses for ~2 seconds.
After the intro ends, confirm ambient sound fades out and the screen transitions smoothly to NODEBREAK.html.
findings: All 8 improvements implemented in a single index.html pass. IMP-07: scanCanvas added after brainCanvas in HTML; resize() updated; drawScanLine() uses its own RAF loop started inside the startBtn click handler (scanLineRunning flag gates it); brainCanvas gets CSS drop-shadow chromatic aberration. IMP-01: startAmbience(audioCtx) called from startBtn click with the AudioContext created there; ambientGain/ambientCtx exposed at script scope for scheduleEndTransition fade-out. IMP-02: pulseIntensity declared at scope; set to 1.0 on each audio line start in showNextDialogue; decays 0.008/frame in drawBrain; breathScale multiplied by (1 + pulseIntensity*0.25); pulse spawn threshold is (0.8 - pulseIntensity*0.5). IMP-06a: awakeSurgeFrames=150 set when isAwake triggers; during surge, Math.random()>0.2 fires up to 3 pulses per node; counter decremented each drawBrain frame. IMP-06b: active connections get a 2.5px wide pass at alpha 0.08 before the normal 0.5px line. IMP-03: @keyframes glitch defined; .vn-text.glitch and .vn-name.glitch classes toggled in showNextDialogue based on step.alert. IMP-04: typewriterReveal(element, text, speed) function with setInterval; speeds: 30ms normal, 90ms awaken, 200ms ellipsis; alert lines typewrite into .alert-text span; previous timer always cleared at start of each call. IMP-05: #bootTerminal div inside .ui-container at z-index:8; showBootTerminal() called at the 3500ms eyelid-open mark; types 6 boot lines sequentially at 60ms/char with 300ms between lines; fades out after 1500ms post-completion (boot terminal and node-spawning intentionally overlap per spec).
